title: Refining incidence systems while preserving the automorphism pair
author: Antonio D\'iaz Ramos, R\'emi Molinier, Antonio Viruel
work: Every finite group is represented by a finite incidence geometry
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a colored graph refinement that removes cliques of rank greater than two and degree-zero/one vertices while preserving the full correlation group together with its type-preserving subgroup. The non-routine obligation is to make the two new color classes intrinsically recognizable by their distinct cardinalities, use the attached rigid ray-and-tail gadgets to kill the kernel of restriction, and prove that every original correlation extends uniquely and preserves the distinguished subgroup. The author proves all three parts in the retained argument; no realization theorem supplies this construction.
